definitions.explanation: In all of recorded history. Used as a modifier before superlatives to emphasize something as the most extreme or notable in history.

examples.japanese: {史上|しじょう}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧だ。
examples.english: It is the highest record in history.

examples.japanese: {史上|しじょう}⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{快挙|かいきょ}→快挙：12579_kaikyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成|な}し{遂|と}げた→成し遂げる：12632_nashitogeru⟧。

⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧{史上|しじょう}⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧だった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was announced that this summer was the hottest on record.

notes:
Almost always appears before superlatives like ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧ (highest), ⟦{最悪|さいあく}→最悪：13009_saiaku⟧ (worst), ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧ (biggest), or ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧ (first time). Very common in news headlines and sports commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {史上|しじょう}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧: the highest in history
- {史上|しじょう}⟦{最悪|さいあく}→最悪：13009_saiaku⟧: the worst in history
- {史上|しじょう}⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧: for the first time in history
- {史上|しじょう}{最年少|さいねんしょう}: the youngest in history
